first_message.raw_markdown:
Hi ARC Prize team (@gregkamradt),

Could you clarify how two parts of the Winner License section apply to a pretrained model whose licence is not OSI-approved - specifically Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, released under the Qwen Community License 1.0?

Rule 5.a.1.a: "Submissions are required to have open source system, open source model, and open source weights/parameters, as defined in the checklist from the Open Source AI definition by the Open Source Initiative."

Rule 5.a.3: "In the event that input data or pretrained models with an incompatible license are used to generate your winning solution, you do not need to grant an open source license in the preceding Section for that data and/or model(s)."

The Qwen Community License 1.0 permits use, modification and redistribution, but it is not on the OSI list of approved licences, and it asks some commercial licensees to obtain a separate licence from Qwen.

Question: can a prize-eligible solution use the Qwen3.8-Flash-Next weights under rule 5.a.3 (with all of our own code and methods released under the required licence), or does rule 5.a.1.a exclude such a model?

Several public notebooks in this competition already run Flash-Next, so a clear answer would help everyone. Thank you!
